text:
nora (design): dropped a micro-proto for the 'create-rule' form. open questions: inline errors vs top banner, required-field signal in dense lists, and bulk-delete confirmation (toast undo vs typed-confirm). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mini/create-rule
ben (product): for onboarding keep friction low -> gentle inline hints. for admin flows prefer explicit required labels.
jin (eng): inline works well with field validators. watch layout shift; reserve space or animate. debounce server checks (400ms).
claire (a11y): accessibility: asterisk alone is ambiguous. always add aria-required="true" and aria-describedby linking to helper/error. use role="alert" for blocking errors.
nora (design): plan: default = small "Required" under fields for onboarding, use "(req)" suffix for dense rows. validation: polite onChange hints, assertive onSubmit errors and focus to first invalid.
ben (product): bulk-delete: toast-undo for <=20, modal+checkbox for 21-200, typed-confirm for >200 or shared resources. measure accidental-deletes and restore rate.
jin (eng): typed-confirm needs server-side verify against stable id. undo needs soft-delete retention. checkbox is cheapest.
claire (a11y): typed-confirm can block screenreader users; provide an alternative like a checkbox and clear aria-labels. avoid relying on placeholder text.
ops-bot: design-lint: contrast tokens OK; manual check recommended for error-red on small text. :robot_face:
nora (design): action items: I'll update Figma with the two required-marker mocks, add aria notes in comments, and prototype toast+checkbox variants. will loop everyone for review.
